data_objects.name: news_articles_with_sentiment
data_objects.meaning: News article records with publication metadata, links, article text, and sentiment score fields.
data_objects.notes: The sentiment method and score calibration are not named in the table.

variables.name: Unnamed: 0
variables.meaning: Sequential row index retained from a prior table export.

variables.name: author
variables.meaning: Author or byline associated with the article.

variables.name: urlToImage
variables.meaning: Web address of an image associated with the article.

variables.name: text
variables.meaning: Article body, transcript, or other full-text content stored for the item.

variables.name: neg
variables.meaning: Negative sentiment component score for the text record.

variables.name: neu
variables.meaning: Neutral sentiment component score for the text record.

variables.name: pos
variables.meaning: Positive sentiment component score for the text record.

variables.name: compound
variables.meaning: Combined overall sentiment score for the text record.

structure.description: Each row represents a news item; source and publication metadata accompany textual content and four sentiment fields.
Unnamed: 0 is an export index rather than an explicitly named article identifier; url is the available article-level locator.

uncertainties: The table does not identify which text field or combination of fields the sentiment scores describe.
The score algorithm, scale definitions, time zone, and treatment of transcript boilerplate are unspecified.
annotation_notes: The sentiment columns are described by their visible labels without attributing a specific scoring system.
